summary: Alvotech filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of 22,666,667 ordinary shares at $3.75 per share, with gross proceeds of ~$85 million. The filing also describes a concurrent private placement of 17,826,666 shares at the same price for an additional ~$66.85 million to EEA professional clients. Shares trade on Nasdaq and Nasdaq Iceland under ALVO. Underwriters include BofA, Jefferies, and Evercore ISI. This is a standard equity capital raise via a shelf takedown, not a special situation. The offering is expected to close on June 17, 2026. No strategic transaction, activism, or corporate event is involved.
